title: My Journey to Real Estate - Gloria Miller
description:
✨ My Journey to Real Estate 💖

Today, I want to share my life story with you. From being born in Mexico and moving to the US at the age of eight, to overcoming immense challenges and finding my passion in real estate, my journey has been quite a ride.
My story includes working in the fields, becoming a young mother, pursuing education, and eventually discovering my true calling in real estate.
Join me on this amazing adventure and see how faith, perseverance, and community support have shaped my life and career. Through every hardship and triumph, I've seen God's hand guiding me, opening doors, and providing the strength to keep moving forward. I truly believe that with God's grace, anything is possible. ❤
